name: Đừng có nhảy
source:
The story of a girl, named Thu. Through this, you will play the role of her through Thu's perspective. She has a "close" friend named Dong, and he has some psychological problems. Your task is very simple, don't let him jump...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230906071237/https://don-hi.itch.io/dont-jump]Itch.io[/url]]
